meta.title: Privacy policy | Imagine PPTP Prints
meta.description: What Imagine PPTP Prints collects when you request a quote, how it is used, which services handle it, and how to have it deleted.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you request a quote, we receive what you enter in the form and any files you attach. Only your name, email, service and project details are required. Phone number, contact preference and deadline are optional.
If you call, text, message us on WhatsApp or email us, we receive what you send.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: We use your information only to prepare your quote, make and deliver your order, and contact you about it. We don’t sell it, rent it or share it for advertising.

sections.title: Services that handle your information
body: Netlify hosts this website and receives quote form submissions, including attached files. Netlify may screen submissions for spam.
Our business email runs on Gmail, so Google stores copies of quote requests and emails.
If you contact us through WhatsApp, Facebook or TikTok, or buy from our Shopify store, that company’s own privacy policy also applies.
This site doesn’t load ads, analytics, tracking pixels or social media widgets. Its fonts and images are served from our own site.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep quote requests, messages and files only while we need them for your order, a possible reprint and our business records. Then we delete them.

sections.title: Cookie policy
body: This site doesn’t set cookies. It doesn’t use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.

It saves your light or dark mode choice in your own browser’s storage. That way, the site looks the way you picked next time. That choice never leaves your device, and you can clear it in your browser settings.
Because nothing is tracked, there’s nothing to opt in to, so we don’t show a cookie banner. If we ever add analytics or advertising, we’ll ask for your consent first.

sections.title: Children’s privacy
sections.body: This site isn’t directed at children under 13, and we don’t knowingly collect their information. If a parent or guardian believes their child sent us information, contact us and we’ll delete it.

sections.title: Emails from us
sections.body: We only email you about your quote or order. We don’t send newsletters or marketing emails. If we ever start one, it will be opt-in, and every email will have an unsubscribe link.

sections.title: See, correct or delete your information
body: You can ask us at any time to show you, correct or delete the information and files we have about you. Email us with the button below, or call or text us. We’ll confirm once it’s done, within 30 days.
We may keep basic records of paid orders where the law requires it, for example for taxes.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we change this policy, we’ll update the date at the top of this page.
